This role is responsible for maintaining the quality, stability, and performance of a high-volume Shopify commerce platform during weekday evening or overnight hours.

You will provide continuous QA coverage across storefront, checkout, subscriptions, payments, themes, and third-party integrations.

The position combines real-time production monitoring with structured manual and automated testing of new releases and platform changes.

You will play a critical role in identifying customer-facing and revenue-impacting issues before they affect the wider business.

Working closely with developers, you will document defects, validate fixes, participate in release reviews, and escalate urgent issues when required.

Triage and document defects in ClickUp and GitHub Issues with clear reproduction steps, supporting screenshots or videos, severity classifications, and relevant technical context.
Collaborate directly with developers through GitHub issues and pull-request review comments, helping identify potential root causes and validating fixes.

Prepare thorough shift handoff notes at the beginning and end of each coverage window so open issues, risks, and priorities are communicated clearly between teams.
Respond promptly to automated uptime and platform alerts and maintain reliable coverage throughout the assigned Monday–Friday EST schedule.

Requirements

5+ years of professional experience in QA, software testing, or a closely related discipline, ideally within a fast-paced agency, e-commerce business, or high-growth direct-to-consumer environment.
Strong hands-on knowledge of the Shopify ecosystem, including Shopify Admin, themes, apps, metafields, and storefront architecture.
Proficiency with Shopify Liquid and the ability to read and understand template logic to investigate defects and identify potential causes.
Practical experience working with GitHub, including branches, pull requests, diffs, issue tracking, and code-review discussions.
Solid understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with enough technical depth to investigate storefront issues and communicate effectively with developers.
Experience writing structured manual test cases, conducting regression testing, triaging defects, assigning severity, and validating issues across browsers and devices.
Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly through asynchronous bug reports, handoff documentation, and developer discussions.
Strong attention to detail and a rigorous approach to quality, particularly when testing customer-facing and revenue-critical commerce flows.
Ability to work independently during evening or overnight hours with minimal supervision, while proactively communicating risks, blockers, and incidents.
Experience with subscription commerce platforms such as Recharge, Skio, or Loop is a plus.
Familiarity with automated testing frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium is advantageous.
Experience with Shopify's theme editor and Online Store 2.0 sections and blocks is beneficial.
Exposure to conversion-rate optimization, Core Web Vitals, site-speed monitoring, GA4, or Shopify Analytics is a plus.

Choice of a consistent Monday–Friday weekday rotation: 5:00 PM–1:00 AM EST or 1:00 AM–9:00 AM EST.
Opportunity to work in a dedicated QA function providing continuous coverage for a Shopify commerce platform.
High level of ownership and autonomy, with the opportunity to directly influence storefront reliability, customer experience, and revenue protection.
Direct collaboration with senior developers and clear escalation paths for production issues.
Structured shift handoffs and asynchronous workflows designed to support continuous operations across coverage windows.
Exposure to Shopify, subscription commerce, third-party integrations, release validation, and both manual and automated QA practices.

Why this internship matters 

Our ISC team brings together machinery, automation, controls, software, and practical user needs. Clear visual communication helps people understand equipment quickly, while sustainable quality practices help development teams create reliable software with confidence. We work collaboratively and value curiosity, ownership, practical thinking, and continuous improvement.

You will investigate the human and organizational side of quality improvement. Your focus will include how testing practices, developer ownership of quality, and gradual process change can be introduced in ways that teams genuinely adopt. Your findings and recommendations will complement the technical automated-testing work within the ISC team.

Turn a broad improvement opportunity into a clear project plan, research approach, and achievable deliverables.
